free_resources.title: Meditation for Anxiety
free_resources.description: A free guide from the Medito Foundation on how meditation can help with anxious thinking, with short breathing, body-scan, grounding and loving-kindness practices to try straight away. It points to the free app's stress and anxiety section and says plainly that meditation doesn't replace professional treatment.

left_out: Meditation for Sleep page: says mindfulness-based approaches are 'as effective as sleep medication for some people', which reads as replacing medication; left out.
flags: Meditation for Anxiety cites studies on reducing anxiety symptoms; it makes no cure claim and says meditation is not a replacement for professional treatment. Kept.
